plan.notes: Sources (all official, retrieved 2026-09-30): (1) the official EMU Psychology Department flowchart 'GENERAL PSYCHOLOGY MAJOR 44 HOURS' (effective Fall 2020+) for the major structure, sequencing rules and the minor requirement; (2) the official EMU catalog program pages 'Program: Psychology | BS' and 'Program: Psychology [BS] - MiTransfer Pathway' for course codes, titles, credits and group lists; (3) the official EMU General Education worksheet (FA22) for gen-ed structure. catalog.emich.edu presents an AWS WAF challenge to automated fetching, so catalog content was verified through the search index of the official catalog pages and official emich.edu documents; every code, title and credit below comes from those official sources. The 44-hour General Psychology structure is used (the 32-39-hour figure on one catalog snapshot is older). Group picks: Developmental PSY 321, Learning/Cognition PSY 358, Sociocultural PSY 309, Health Services PSY 360, Biological Bases PSY 457; PSY electives PSY 322, PSY 351, PSY 451. MATH 105 covers the major MATH prerequisite and GEQR. 44 major + 3 MATH + 34 gen-ed = 81 specified credits; free-elective choice slots (39 cr) reach 120. IMPORTANT: the psychology major requires a minor for graduation - the elective space fits a typical 20-24 credit minor plus free electives; choose the minor with an advisor. PSY 453 is taken at the end of the major. Verify semester offerings before registering.
